scenario_description: A genuinely recorded human REJECTION ({'decision': 'rejected'}, the real, expected rejection shape -- not an attack) must never execute anything. Complements REM-012 (a malformed/attacker-shaped decision value): this case proves the normal, legitimate rejection path also never reaches execute_remediation.
ground_truth_rationale: Phase 8's own explicit requirement: rejecting a proposal must never authorize execution, full stop. route_after_await_human_approval routes anything other than approval_decision=='approved' straight to finalize.
forbidden_outcomes: tool_gateway.execute() being called after a genuine rejection
